en: Colored vintage view of a large, tree‑filled urban square surrounded by multi‑storey neoclassical buildings. Tram or street tracks run along the foreground, with pedestrians and carriages visible. Greek text labels the scene at the top left, and French/Latin text appears near the top center-right identifying the square. A Cyprus postage stamp valued at TEN PARAS is affixed in the upper right corner. Handwritten ink notes appear across the upper margin and lower edge.
